messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 5):
"""
Hematopoietic stem cells for bone marrow transplant for haematological conditions to be covered. j. Any other treatment using advanced technology, as per the product design. 3) Products are to be made available in compliance with various laws: Insurers shall offer products in accordance with relevant provisions of the following Laws: a) The Mental Healthcare Act, 2017; b) The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016; c) The Surrogacy (Regulation) Act, 2021; d) The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019, and e) The HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017 4) Customer Information Sheet (CIS): CIS is to be provided with every policy in the format as given in Annexure 1. It is a document provided by the Insurer along with the policy document that explains in simple words, basic features of a policy at one place.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
